entries.reason: The published source does not compile even with Arduino 1.0.5. Binary recovery reconstructs selected missing calculations and state machines, but not the complete temperature engine, peripherals, probe or modern queue/planner bindings. Account for every missing behavior with authoritative source or corroborated reconstruction before release.
Isolated production decoder passes stock-host-derived fixtures, ASan/UBSan boundary checks and an ATmega2560 object compile. Queue and hardware integration remain separately unimplemented.

Packet receiver, 96-byte payload plus terminator storage, dispatch, asynchronous output, resend RX discard, sequence/ack timing and planner-credit reporting must integrate with the modern production queue.

Schematic audit corroborates stock signals, USART2 and printhead peripherals, but firmware BOARD_REV_I assumptions differ from the published 1548-I divider/safety circuit. Exact production revision mapping and assembly remain unresolved; do not enable outputs from the title alone.

Exact stock tables, factor-8 conversion and compensation math are implemented and tested separately. Board/channel selection, reference calibration, acquisition freshness, saturation and sensor-fault integration remain unimplemented.

PID math, removal allowance, progress-watchdog state and power budgeting are recovered and independently tested. ISR cadence, actual sensor/presence acquisition, every heater-output safety gate and modern thermal protection integration remain unimplemented.

Board revision I uses safety-pin output sequencing; Stop.h and stale Marlin.h reason definitions conflict. Verify relay, sensor faults, endstops, watchdog, timeout and recovery behavior for stock hardware.

Planner-credit, negative rounded tool-offset and executed-step coordinate helpers are recovered. Modern planner/stepper integration, interrupt ordering, runtime directions, homing and travel-limit enforcement remain unimplemented.

Shipped simulator instructions corroborate the missing capacitive probe constants and buffers. Full algorithm, I2C acquisition, cadence, abort/stop behavior, numeric parity and host result sequence remain unimplemented.
Preserve DS2482/DS2431 serial and EEPROM read/write behavior, validation, returned hex formatting, presence and removal policy.
Port nonblocking I2C priorities, communication failures, PCA9635/PCA9632 lighting and fan behavior without interrupt or timer ownership conflicts.
On connect stock host sends M115/M80 then forces all property links. Preserve host-owned calibration, geometry, settings and temperature coefficients; no modern EEPROM override.

Stock startup verifies and may overwrite MCU firmware from configured jedi.hex. Installation must preserve backup/calibration and replace the configured image; document stock update rollback behavior and verify image layout.

Dedicated target must compile with verified pins/sensors, reserve application flash below 0x3e000, report SRAM with stack/interrupt headroom, and emit identified artifacts. Upstream smoke build is insufficient.

Run stock-host-derived initialization, calibration, probing, heating, tool change, stop and recovery scenarios against production compatibility code and mocked hardware; every required inventory row must be verified.

No printer is available. Before any drop-in claim, verify installed host/board revision, back up firmware/calibration and stage cold startup, sensors, homing, probing, heaters and dual-material tests.
evidence: user:stock UM3 Extended unavailable for hardware tests

entries.reason: Modern equivalents exist; compare legacy units, parameters, homing/error behavior, flow factors, offsets and coordinate ownership before accepting.
Capacitive probe constants are recovered, but command/result formatting and motion/sampling/abort integration remain unimplemented.
Thermal, relay, removal and safety integration are unresolved; preserve extended status, power/PID/current units and error mapping.
Pin protection, fan/light controllers and print-core EEPROM interfaces need dedicated verified handlers.
Exact response fields and startup identification need comparison with stock host parsing.
Vendor aborts planned motion and returns real positions; modern Marlin M401 deploys a probe.
Stock UM3 has no flow sensor; M405 disable still comes from host property links. Other maintenance commands require audit before declaring not applicable.
Host runtime movement bounds/directions must affect planner, stepper and homing consistently.
Measured*factor+offset calculation is implemented and tested. Host M12005/M12006 runtime setters and application to every acquired temperature and safety threshold remain unimplemented.
Verify board-ID responses; TMC2130 register access is only for non-stock/newer boards and must not initialize stock outputs.

Signed tables exactly match both shipped binaries. Conversion/compensation passes 86 ARM instruction-replay outputs plus boundary and invalid-input tests; AVR object compile passes. Acquisition and fault handling are separate gates.

Recovered sample interval, gains, state and clipping pass 177 ARM instruction-replay outputs plus invalid-input tests; AVR object compile passes. No heater output is driven and exact cross-architecture rounding is not established.

Removal requests and full-power progress watchdog match 31 ARM replay outcomes; native tests also cover thresholds, invalid values and clock wrap. The helper returns fault state; actual shutdown/latching and all output-path integration remain separate gates.

Two-slot and temperature-dependent bed allocator passes 12 ARM bed replay outputs and 26880 independent allocation invariants. Explicit fail-closed validation and global slot limiting are documented defensive departures; output integration remains separate.

Shipped instructions establish planner ring capacity, signed rounded tool offsets and executed-step reconstruction. Native boundary/overflow tests and AVR compile pass. ROM defaults match AVR bytes; live planner, homing and probing remain separate gates.

limitations: Static package/source inspection only; no stock firmware execution or physical printer testing.
SHA-256 pins inspected package bytes but does not independently verify vendor signature.
Candidate upstream command implementations are not verified UM3 compatibility.
Host defaults do not resolve AVR thermal conversion, timing, pin maps or safety logic.
